entities.name: Vannemir
entities.description: Terisian warrior raised from the dead to save his world from Heidar.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Tyrant whose rule Vannemir's quest prevented.

entities.name: Guldark
entities.description: Torgash warlord Vannemir killed in a duel.

entities.name: Pik
entities.description: Blind boy whose family was brutalized by orcs; identified the raiding clan.

entities.name: Taaveti of Kelsinko
entities.description: Explained Vannemir's mission and gave information about Ysidra.

entities.name: Isa
entities.description: Fylgja spirit bound to Vannemir's Runeblade, which healed him in the duel.

entities.name: Runeblade
entities.description: Weapon of great power carried by Vannemir.

events.summary: Vannemir dies defending his village from orc raiders and is resurrected by the Valkyrie Ysidra.
events.quote: He died defending his village from orc raiders, only to be resurrected by a Valkyrie named Ysidra

events.summary: Vannemir is given a mission to rescue a prisoner from Guldark and prevent Heidar's tyranny.
events.quote: to rescue a prisoner from the Torgash warlord Guldark

events.summary: Vannemir challenges Guldark to a duel in the Torgash camp.
events.quote: Vannemir strode into the Torgash camp and challenged Warlord Guldark to a duel.

events.summary: Isa heals Vannemir several times, letting him kill Guldark and his shaman and disperse the raiders.
events.quote: allowing him to kill both Guldark and his shaman, and disperse the remaining raiders

events.summary: Vannemir frees Pik's sister and an elven girl, setting Terisiare on the path to victory.

relations.quote: allowing him to kill both Guldark and his shaman, and disperse the remaining raiders
to fulfill his destiny and save his world from being destroyed by
the blind boy Pik, who identified the clan of Torgash raiders
He was aided in his quest by Taaveti of Kelsinko
